info.name: HotelManager API
info.description:
FlavorFind HotelManager — multi-tenant POS & reservation backend.

**Setup:**
1. Set `base_url` variable to `https://flavorfind-hotel.onrender.com` (or `http://localhost:8000` locally)
2. Set `tenant_slug` to your tenant slug (e.g. `demo`)
3. Run **Register** or **Login** — the token is auto-saved to `auth_token`
4. All protected requests use `auth_token` automatically

request.description: Returns service status. No auth or tenant required.
Register a new user for a tenant. Auto-saves token to `auth_token`.
Login and get a Sanctum token. Auto-saves token to `auth_token`.
Returns the authenticated user's profile.
Revokes current token and issues a new one. Auto-saves new token.
Revokes the current token. Clears `auth_token` variable.
Returns the current tenant's profile and settings.
Update tenant settings. Requires admin role.
Dashboard stats — orders today, revenue, active tables, reservations.
List all staff for the tenant. Requires admin or manager role.
Create a new staff account. Auto-saves new staff ID to `staff_id`.
Update a staff member's details. Uses `staff_id` variable.
Change a staff member's role. Valid roles: admin, manager, waiter, cashier, kitchen.
Delete a staff member. Uses `staff_id` variable.
Only works if floor has no tables.
Table must be 'available'. Auto-saves session_id.
Closes session and sets table back to 'available'.
Only works if no open session.
Returns category with all menu items, variants, and modifiers.
Only works if category has no menu items.
Creates order and auto-calculates subtotal, tax (16%), and total. Auto-saves order_id.
Valid statuses: pending → confirmed → preparing → ready → served → paid. Use cancel endpoint to cancel.
Cannot cancel if order is paid or already served.
Returns all confirmed + preparing orders oldest-first (FIFO). Used by kitchen display screen.

Poll this after STK push. If still pending after 15s it queries Safaricom directly.
